TBC test report

Device under test: AVT-8710 (green)

Green case, warmed up (running for some time). Composite in/out, front-panel controls at default. Chain after the TBC is unterminated until the tees arrive, so CH1 reads about 1.9x.

2026-10-13 19:17 56 runs firmware ntsc-gen 0.2.0 sample clock 14.318186 MHz levels 0.0 / 73.0 (sync/white code) colour colour_under

These are observations of the TBC's output, not grades. "Ideal" describes what a perfect TBC of each class would output for that test.

Fault tests

  • lost fields (no signal): rides through up to 6 in a row without falling back to its own pattern or losing sync; cleanly (no garbled fields) up to 0
  • lost fields (snow): rides through up to 6 in a row without falling back to its own pattern or losing sync; cleanly (no garbled fields) up to 0
  • X1 stress 1: clean after stress; 2 stuck/torn or ghosted field(s)
  • X1 stress 2: clean after stress; 11 stuck/torn or ghosted field(s)
  • X1 stress 3: clean after stress; 15 stuck/torn or ghosted field(s)
  • X1 stress 4: clean after stress; 1 stuck/torn or ghosted field(s)
  • X1 stress 5: clean after stress; 4 stuck/torn or ghosted field(s)
